decision.name: SNAPSHOT_ORDER_NOT_COMPLETION_ORDER
decision.finding: Correct prior ambiguity: publication completion order is NOT a valid monotonic-generation guard. A reads old archive snapshot, B reads later appended row at same as_of_ms T, B publishes, then A completes last. Last-writer-wins by publication order incorrectly accepts stale A. A fix needs a causally ordered snapshot version captured at read and compared atomically at publication; as_of_ms alone, content hash alone, and publish-time sequence alone do not establish snapshot freshness. Existing atomic_write_json guarantees complete JSON, not monotonic snapshot freshness. Source-derived risk only; no independent reproduction or production incident.
runnable_no_network_contract: On disposable checkout at exact public SHA, test-only spawn worker A calls runner.run_once(local_dir=tmp_path,network=False,as_of_ms=T); monkeypatch runner.atomic_write_json inside A child to block ONLY immediately before replacing anata_latest.json, after A captured its empty archive snapshot and built its handoff; use bounded multiprocessing Event/Queue and finally release/terminate.

After A_ready, append one valid PIT BTC ETF FlowObservation rowB with effective_at_ms, available_at_ms and observed_at_ms <= T using append_observations; run worker B at identical T on same local_dir to completion; assert B anata_output source_evidence contains rowB source_record_id and A handoff excludes it.

Before releasing A, assert disk anata_latest.json equals B's complete JSON. Release A, assert both child exitcodes 0 and final disk handoff still equals B's (or explicitly ordered superseding generation) and includes rowB; assert one archive row and no duplicates. Baseline at current SHA expected to fail stale-retention assertion; record observed result rather than assert an unexecuted failure.

Negative controls: a guard based only on as_of_ms T or write-completion order must fail; ensure snapshot-order rule is preserved when equal T and when bounded history max_records=100000 saturates (record count alone is not a durable generation token). Do not require unrelated latest.json and audit_latest.json to update transactionally.

Commands: python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_runner_single_handoff_stale.py; python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_concurrent_dedup.py part2/capital_flow/tests/test_archive_reader_writer_visibility.py; python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests. Capture exact git HEAD, test-overlay hash, exit codes, non-skipped counts, logs and red/green.
